versions.changelog:
- Skill renamed to "openclaw-ui-designer" and updated metadata for OpenClaw compatibility.
- Tags expanded to include keywords like "openclaw", "accessibility", "wcag", "responsive", and "color-palette".
- Skill descriptions enhanced for clarity and scope in SKILL.md and README files.
- No code or functionality changes; documentation and metadata improvements only.

- All scripts are now bundled within the package; no external cloning or downloads required.
- Added new scripts: color-palette.py, component-gen.py, design-consult.py, and a default config file.
- Documentation improved for usage, configuration, file access, and security.
- Removed references to non-existent scripts (design-review.py, accessibility-check.py) from documentation.
- Added security and permission notes detailing local-only operation and no external dependencies.
- README and English documentation added.

UI Designer initial release.

- 提供专业 UI 设计建议，包括配色、字体、组件、布局等
- 支持设计咨询、配色方案生成、组件代码生成、设计审查、可访问性检查等脚本
- 涵盖多种设计风格和应用场景，适用于 Web、移动端等多端界面
- 支持创建和管理设计系统及组件库
- 提供详细安装、使用和配置说明
